title: 第21章 谈判第22章 铁器到手
slug: 从哥布林开始骑马砍杀
content_zh:
兰斯少爷被李秦武抓住后，昏迷了一整天，醒来后他发现自己被挂在杆上当棋，整个人都吓尿了，尤其是下面到处都是哥布林，让他感觉堕入了魔窟。
之后这家伙被带到李秦武身边，李秦武想要询问他一些情报，可这家伙恐惧的咿咿呀呀大叫，他说的未知语言在李秦武耳中和疯狂戴夫似的，歪比巴卜歪比巴卜根本听不懂。
李秦武打算发挥这人的最后价值，coSpLAY耐砍王路易十六，给城堡里的人上上压力。
“少爷！”
哈娜小姐悲呼一声，她看自家少爷变成魔物的玩具，悲从心来，立刻就想下去救人，却被雷奥骑士拦住了。
“哈娜小姐冷静一点，卑鄙的哥布林想引你下去削减我们的力量，看见森林边那几个大哥布林了吗？他们的弓弩都上了弦！”
哈娜小姐往森林边缘看了一眼，这才发现几个大哥布林做好了战斗准备，虎视眈眈看着木堡这边。
蒙德管家提议道：“哈娜小姐你不是会语言魔法吗？这家伙带着少爷前来应该是打算说点什么，不如听听他要说什么！”
哈娜小姐点了点头，这时李秦武的声音也传来了。
“里面的人类！有没有会说哥布林语的，出来当个翻译，不然这家伙可就要cos路易十六了！”
李秦武拔出长剑，一脚踹在兰斯少爷的腿关节，把这个刚站起来的家伙踹的又跪在地上，然后将长剑架在他的脖子上。
兰斯少爷吓得嗷一声喊。
“九命啊！我不要被哥布林吃掉啊！”
哈娜小姐怒火中烧。
“住手该死的哥布林！不准对领主大人无礼！”
清脆的女声传入李秦武的耳中，而且是他能听得懂的语言，李秦武满脸诧异，一看城墙上说话的是马猴烧酒，也就了然了，翻译魔法嘛，也是异世界标配了。
而且对面说的这内容……
“原来你是领主啊，妈的我还以为你只是个小角色呢，法师小姐，多谢你提醒啊，原来我还抓了条大鱼！桀桀桀桀桀！”
李秦武发出每天吃一只魂殿大长老才能发出的声音，哈娜小姐顿时脸色苍白，发现自己干了件蠢事。
雷奥骑士和蒙德管家看哈娜小姐脸色苍白，不知道她和那个哥布林说了什么，催促她翻译翻译。

哈娜小姐结结巴巴的翻译后，两人也是脸色一变，看哈娜小姐像看傻逼。
tmd，哥布林根本不知道抓的是城堡头号人物，你直接把答案漏给人家了，这真是……可爱的猪猪女孩。
不过现在不是互相指责的时候，雷奥骑士斩钉截铁道：“哈娜小姐，现在我是城堡最高军事指挥，从现在开始你不要说和翻译无关的任何话，我说一句你翻译一句。
你问问那只哥布林是谁？为什么要入侵我们的领地！”
自知坏事的哈娜小姐点了点头，不敢再有任何动作，老实翻译了雷奥骑士的话。
content_en:
After Master Lance was caught by Li Qinwu, he was in a coma for a whole day. When he woke up, he found that he was hung on a pole as a chess piece. He was so frightened that he peed, especially because there were goblins everywhere below, which made him feel like he had fallen into a devil's cave.
Afterwards, this guy was brought to Li Qinwu. Li Qinwu wanted to ask him for some information, but this guy was babbling and screaming in fear. The unknown language he spoke sounded like Crazy Dave to Li Qinwu's ears, and Waibibabu couldn't understand it at all.
Li Qinwu planned to use this person's final value, coSpLAY to kill King Louis XVI, and put pressure on the people in the castle.
"Master!"
Miss Hana cried out sadly. She felt sad when she saw her young master turned into a toy of monsters. She immediately wanted to go to save people, but was stopped by Leo Knight.
"Miss Hana, calm down. The despicable goblins want to lure you down to reduce our power. Have you seen those big goblins at the edge of the forest? Their crossbows are all loaded!"
Miss Hana glanced towards the edge of the forest, and then she realized that several big goblins were ready for battle, looking at the wooden castle with eager eyes.
Butler Mond suggested: "Miss Hana, don't you know language magic? This guy brought the young master here probably intends to say something, why not listen to what he has to say!"
Miss Hana nodded, and then Li Qinwu's voice came.
"Humans inside! Is there anyone who can speak Goblin? Come out and act as a translator, otherwise this guy will be cosplaying Louis XVI!"
Li Qinwu pulled out his long sword, kicked Master Lance's leg joint, and kicked the guy who had just stood up to kneel on the ground again, and then put the long sword on his neck.
Master Lance screamed in fright.
"Nine lives! I don't want to be eaten by goblins!"
Miss Hana was furious.
"Stop the damn Goblin! Don't be rude to the Lord!"
A crisp female voice came to Li Qinwu's ears, and it was in a language he could understand. Li Qinwu was full of surprise. When he saw that the person speaking on the wall was Mahou Shaju, he understood that translation magic was also standard in other worlds.
And what’s said on the other side...
"It turns out you are the lord. Damn it, I thought you were just a small character. Miss Mage, thank you for reminding me. It turns out I caught a big fish! Jiejiejiejiejie!"
Li Qinwu made a sound that could only be made by the elder of the Soul Palace who eats one every day. Miss Hana suddenly turned pale and realized that she had done something stupid.
Knight Leo and Butler Mond saw Miss Hana's pale face and wondered what she had said to the goblin, so they urged her to translate.
After Miss Hana's stammering translation, the expressions of the two of them also changed. They looked at Miss Hana as if she were an idiot.
Tmd, the goblin didn’t even know that he was arresting the number one person in the castle. You just leaked the answer to others. This is really... a cute pig girl.
But now is not the time to blame each other. Knight Leo said categorically: "Miss Hana, now I am the highest military commander of the castle. From now on, you should not say anything that has nothing to do with translation. You will translate everything I say."
Who is that goblin? Why are you invading our territory? "
Miss Hana, who knew that she was doing something bad, nodded, did not dare to make any more moves, and honestly translated Leo Knight's words.
